briefing.en: Build a satellite that watches wildfires, floods and crops for at least 3 years. You have room for up to 3 instruments; the budget and launch deadline are below. Every choice costs mass, power, money, data or time.
briefing.zh-TW: 打造一顆監測野火、洪水和農作物的衛星，至少運作 3 年。最多裝 3 台儀器，預算和發射期限見下方。每個選擇都要付出質量、電力、金錢、資料或時間。

text.en: Plan at least the 3-year target and make it to the end.
text.zh-TW: 任務至少規劃 3 年，而且要撐到最後。

text.en: Keep at least 15% of the budget in reserve.
text.zh-TW: 預算至少保留 15% 準備金。

text.en: Reach a science score of 60 or more.
text.zh-TW: 科學分數達到 60 分以上。

text.en: Fire-watch partners need a thermal infrared imager on board.
text.zh-TW: 野火監測合作單位需要一台熱紅外線成像儀。

text.en: Keep the required margin on both mass and power.
text.zh-TW: 質量和電力都要保留規定的餘裕。

text.en: Bring home at least 90% of the data collected.
text.zh-TW: 至少傳回 90% 收集到的資料。

text.en: Lose almost nothing: return 97% of the data.
text.zh-TW: 幾乎不能掉資料：傳回 97% 的資料。

briefing.en: Map the lunar surface from a 100 km orbit for 2 years. Getting there is expensive, the orbit decays fast, and every byte must cross 384,000 km.
briefing.zh-TW: 從 100 公里高的月球軌道繪製月面地圖 2 年。到月球很貴、軌道掉得快，每筆資料都要飛 38 萬公里回家。

text.en: Map for the full 2 years.
text.zh-TW: 完整測繪 2 年。

text.en: Keep at least 10% of the budget in reserve.
text.zh-TW: 預算至少保留 10% 準備金。

text.en: Reach a science score of 55 or more.
text.zh-TW: 科學分數達到 55 分以上。

text.en: The mineral team needs a multispectral imager.
text.zh-TW: 礦物研究小組需要一台多光譜成像儀。

text.en: Keep the required margin on both mass and power.
text.zh-TW: 質量和電力都要保留規定的餘裕。

text.en: Return at least 85% of the data across 384,000 km.
text.zh-TW: 跨越 38 萬公里傳回至少 85% 的資料。

text.en: Return 95% of the data: the map must have no holes.
text.zh-TW: 傳回 95% 的資料：地圖不能有破洞。

briefing.en: Fire season is about to start. Design a satellite that spots wildfires while they are still small and tells the fire service within 30 minutes.
briefing.zh-TW: 火災季即將開始。你們要設計一顆衛星，在野火剛燒起來時就發現它，並在 30 分鐘內通知消防單位。

text.en: Pick the orbit that passes over at 13:30 local time.
text.zh-TW: 選下午 13:30 過境的軌道。

text.en: Watch for the full 3 years and make it to the end.
text.zh-TW: 完整監測 3 年，而且要撐到最後。

text.en: Stay within the budget.
text.zh-TW: 不能超出預算。

text.en: Keep 10% of it in reserve for surprises, so spend no more than 90%.
text.zh-TW: 其中 10% 要保留給意外，開銷壓在九成以內。

text.en: Fly a mid-wave infrared fire detector (P-7 or P-8).
text.zh-TW: 一定要裝中波紅外線火點儀（P-7 或 P-8）。

text.en: The long-wave thermal imager (P-3) is a must.
text.zh-TW: 長波熱紅外線（P-3）一定要裝。

text.en: The battery must carry the spacecraft through the longest shadow.
text.zh-TW: 電池要撐過最長的地影。

text.en: Keep the required margin on both mass and power.
text.zh-TW: 質量和電力都要保留規定的餘裕。

text.en: Report every fire to the fire service within 30 minutes of seeing it.
text.zh-TW: 看到火點後 30 分鐘內要通報消防單位。

question.zh-TW: 這次任務的目標是什麼？

answer.en: Spot wildfires the moment they start. The sooner a fire is put out, the less it destroys.
answer.zh-TW: 在野火剛起來的時候就發現它。火越早撲滅，損失越小。

question.en: When is the best time to fly over?
question.zh-TW: 衛星什麼時候經過最好？

answer.en: Around 1:30 in the afternoon. It is hot and windy then, and that is when fires start and spread.
answer.zh-TW: 下午一點半左右。那時候氣溫高、風大，最容易起火。

question.en: How long does it have to last?

answer.en: Three fire seasons, {years} years, all the way to the end.
answer.zh-TW: 三個火災季，{years} 年，要撐到最後。

answer.en: {budget} in total: development, the rocket and every year of operations.
answer.zh-TW: 總共 {budget}，包含開發、火箭和每一年的營運費。

question.en: Can we save on the launch?

answer.en: A rideshare costs a fraction of a dedicated rocket, but you go where the main payload goes: this one is headed for a dawn-dusk orbit. If you need the afternoon orbit, you have to book your own small rocket.
answer.zh-TW: 共乘比包一枚火箭便宜很多，但只能去主酬載的軌道：這一趟去的是晨昏軌道。要去下午那條，就得自己包一枚小火箭。

answer.en: The rocket, then the ground stations: every station charges rent every year, so more stations cost more.
answer.zh-TW: 火箭最貴，再來是地面站：每座站每年都要付租金，站越多越貴。

answer.en: A flame is about 800 K, so its light peaks near 4 microns, where an ordinary camera sees nothing.
answer.zh-TW: 火焰大約 800 K，能量集中在 4 微米附近，一般相機看不出來。

answer.en: Last year there were too many false alarms, and the fire service has almost stopped trusting satellites.
answer.zh-TW: 去年誤報太多次，消防單位已經不太相信衛星了。

answer_none.en: If the budget allows, add a long-wave thermal imager. Sun-baked desert and sun glint can fool the fire detector; looking in both bands tells them apart.
answer_none.zh-TW: 有預算的話加一具長波熱紅外線。沙漠被曬熱、或太陽反光，也會讓火點儀誤判；兩個波段一起看就分得出來。

question.en: What should we watch on power?

answer.en: The shadow depends on the orbit. In the orbit you reported, each shadow lasts about {eclipse_min} minutes.
answer.zh-TW: 地影時間看軌道。以目前回報的軌道，每圈地影大約 {eclipse_min} 分鐘。

answer.en: The dawn-dusk orbit sees the Sun most of the year. Even in its eclipse season the shadow is only about 19 minutes, roughly half the afternoon orbit's, so a modest battery is enough.
answer.zh-TW: 晨昏軌道一年大部分時間都照得到太陽。就算在地影季，每圈影子也只有大約 19 分鐘，差不多是下午軌道的一半，中小型電池就夠。

question.en: How much margin do we need?

answer.en: Keep {margin_pct}% margin on both mass and power.
answer.zh-TW: 質量和電力都要留 {margin_pct}% 的餘裕。

question.en: How fast does the data have to come home?
How do we make it in time?

answer.en: More ground stations mean a shorter wait for the next pass, and a faster antenna sends each orbit's data down faster. Then the ground needs about 5 minutes to check it and call the fire service.
answer.zh-TW: 地面站越多，等衛星過站的時間越短；天線越快，每一圈的資料傳得越快。落地後地面還要大約 5 分鐘確認、通知消防單位。

question.en: How much storage do we need?

answer.en: Everything collected between two passes waits in the computer. The standard computer on this mission has plenty.
answer.zh-TW: 兩次通聯之間收集的資料都要先存在電腦裡。這次任務用的標準電腦空間很夠。

name.zh-TW: 改寫歷史：軌道碳觀測衛星（2009）

briefing.en: 2009. NASA's first satellite dedicated to measuring carbon dioxide from space is ready: 441 kg, bound for a 705 km sun-synchronous orbit to join the A-Train. Fly the original design first and see what happened.
briefing.zh-TW: 2009 年。NASA 第一顆專門從太空量測二氧化碳的衛星準備好了：441 公斤，目標是 705 公里的太陽同步軌道，加入 A-Train 衛星編隊。先用原始設計飛一次，看看當年發生了什麼事。

text.en: Operate for the full 2-year design life.
text.zh-TW: 完整運作 2 年設計壽命。

text.en: Stay within 110% of the original budget.
text.zh-TW: 不超過原始預算的 110%。

text.en: Keep the CO2 spectrometer: it is the whole point.
text.zh-TW: 保留二氧化碳光譜儀：這就是任務的意義。

text.en: Reach a science score of 50 or more.
text.zh-TW: 科學分數達到 50 分以上。

text.en: Keep the required margin on both mass and power.
text.zh-TW: 質量和電力都要保留規定的餘裕。

text.en: Return 95% of the carbon measurements.
text.zh-TW: 傳回 95% 的碳量測資料。

text.en: Climate models need 98% of the soundings.
text.zh-TW: 氣候模型需要 98% 的量測資料。

background.en: The Orbiting Carbon Observatory carried three spectrometers to map where carbon dioxide enters and leaves the atmosphere. To save money it was booked on a Taurus XL, a smaller solid-fuel rocket with six successes in seven flights.
background.zh-TW: 軌道碳觀測衛星（OCO）帶著三台光譜儀，要畫出二氧化碳在哪裡進出大氣。為了省錢，它訂了金牛座 XL，一款較小的固體燃料火箭，七次飛行成功六次。

reveal.en: On 24 February 2009 the Taurus XL's payload fairing failed to separate. The extra weight left the rocket about 300 m/s short of orbital velocity, and OCO fell into the ocean near Antarctica. The mishap board could not isolate the exact part that failed. In 2011 the same rocket type lost the Glory satellite the same way.
reveal.zh-TW: 2009 年 2 月 24 日，金牛座 XL 的酬載整流罩沒有分離。多出來的重量讓火箭差了約每秒 300 公尺的入軌速度，OCO 墜入南極附近的海洋。事故調查委員會無法確定是哪個零件失效。2011 年，同型火箭又以同樣方式失去了 Glory 衛星。

real_fix.en: NASA rebuilt the satellite almost unchanged as OCO-2 and, after Glory was also lost on a Taurus XL, moved it to a Delta II 7320 (149 successful flights). OCO-2 reached orbit on 2 July 2014 and has been measuring CO2 ever since. The total investment rose to $467.7M.
real_fix.zh-TW: NASA 幾乎原封不動地重造了衛星，命名 OCO-2；在 Glory 也因金牛座 XL 失敗之後，改用德爾塔 II 7320（成功 149 次）發射。OCO-2 於 2014 年 7 月 2 日入軌，至今仍在量測二氧化碳。總投資增加到 4.677 億美元。
